marie_procure: Heads-up: PO PO-83491 H100 batch split. Vendor says 26/34 clear, 8 held in FRA for customs docs + one firmware SKU mismatch. Need plan for loaners, express, or credit.

leo_vendor: Sorry team. Primary AWB AWB-EU334 -> 26 units ETA 2024-11-10 AMS. Held 8 ETA TBD until ECCN cleared. Options: 6 loaners today (LOAN-AWB-334 ETA 2024-11-08), express 8 (+$4.5k), or 25% credit on delayed units. We can do hybrid: 6 loaners + 2 express.

ana_logistics: If express selected we need amended invoice for broker + insurance uplift. Loaners require AMS staging pre-reserve.

sven_sre: Loaners fine if firmware parity. Provide serials and quick burn logs. Acceptance checks: boots, nvidia-smi present, no ECC errors, token-bench >=90% baseline. We'll gate canary until loaners verified.

harper_finance: Show $/unit net after vendor goodwill. If vendor covers partial surcharge, finance ok with express. Otherwise prefer credit.

leo_vendor: Vendor offer: cover 50% of express surcharge if Redwood takes credit instead of full express. For DOA returns vendor provides prepaid labels to AMS and 10 business day depot turnaround.

marie_procure: Proposal accepted: 6 loaners now, 2 express with 50/50 surcharge split, 20% credit on remaining delayed units. @leo_vendor send amendment; @ana_logistics reserve 6 staging slots; @sven_sre prepare acceptance script.

leo_vendor: Amendment posted and manifests uploaded to vendor-share. AWB LOAN-AWB-334 and AWB-EXP-775 numbers added. Shipping ETA updates in 1h.

rma_bot: [RMA-NEW] RMA ID RMA-20241108-017 created for PO-83491 delayed tranche. Status=ACTION_REQUIRED. Attach photos/logs within 48h to avoid hold.

ana_logistics: Reserving slots and pre-alerting broker now. Need prepaid labels for returns.

sven_sre: Quick acceptance check (run on arrival):
# small script
ssh root@$NODE "nvidia-smi -L && nvidia-smi -q | grep -E 'Product|ECC'"
docker run --rm token-bench --tokens 1024 --min-qps 1000

marie_procure: Thanks all, sign amendment after final doc. Keep AWB updates here.
